searches.reason: The search backend matched uses: and gregkrsak/klyxr in separate prose fragments; neither result was a workflow uses directive.
Returned examples were project README badges, engineering records, compiler documentation, and governance charters—not hosted-Action consumption.

conclusion: No external hosted-Action consumer was identified by the bounded searches. This is not evidence that none exists.
limitations: GitHub code search covers indexed default-branch content and can omit unindexed, private, fork, deleted, non-default-branch, generated, or syntactically varied consumers.
Search tokenization produced false positives for one exact-looking query.
No organization-wide administrative dependency graph was available.
An empty known-external-consumer list is not an absence finding.
This observation confers no acceptance, readiness, execution, or merge authority.
